slides.headline: AI WRITES YOUR BRAND STORY IN 5 MINUTES FLAT
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei chest-up at craftsman's workbench with fountain pen, open leather journal, expression of focused pride, Claude logo glowing warm-orange on bright wood wall, sharp documentary 35mm photo, no legible text.

slides.headline: 1) WRITE YOUR FOUNDING MYTH IN 5 MINUTES
slides.body: At 13, Louis Vuitton walked 400 kilometers across France with nothing. It took him two years to reach Paris. Customers buy the story first. Yours is already there.

slides.headline: 2) WRITE THE WORDS YOUR BEST CLIENT SAYS ABOUT YOU
slides.body:
Most 'About Us' pages are written from the inside looking out.

Flip the perspective and you turn a page visit into a call booked.

slides.headline: 400KM
slides.body:
FROM ONE STORY.

Louis Vuitton walked that far at 13 with nothing but intention to learn a craft. He built the most recognized fashion brand in the world. Your story starts closer than that

slides.headline: 3) NAME THE ENEMY YOUR BRAND FIGHTS
slides.body:
• Nike is against quitting.
• Apple is against conformity.
• Patagonia is against fast fashion.

Every brand that lasts names what it fights.

slides.headline: 4) WRITE YOUR POSITIONING IN ONE SENTENCE
slides.body:
A positioning statement tells the right person they found the right place in under 10 seconds.

The wrong person keeps scrolling. Both outcomes save you time.

slides.headline: 5) WRITE THE VISION THAT KEEPS CLIENTS FOR DECADES
slides.body: Louis Vuitton's brand survived 170 years because the vision was bigger than luggage. Two sentences is the gap between a one-time client and someone who stays for good.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: 5 PROMPTS THAT WRITE THE STORY CLIENTS PAY FOR
slides.body:
1) Write your founding myth
2) Write what your best client says
3) Name the enemy you fight
4) Write your positioning
5) Write the vision

Daily AI news + real skills

caption:
Swipe for 5 Claude prompts that write your entire brand story from scratch. 📖

Write your founding myth, write what your best client says about you, name the enemy your brand fights, write your positioning in one sentence, write the vision that keeps clients for decades.

Louis Vuitton walked 400 kilometers at 13 years old, reached Paris two years later, and built the most recognized fashion brand in history from one story about craft and sacrifice. Every business has a story worth that much. AI writes yours tonight.
Running a business? DM us "AI" and we will show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Louis Vuitton brand history, Anthropic
